scope: Original50 development archives, descriptive contact chronology. Go paired regulator contrast is within route; Out versus Go is observational and differs in route, throw, posture, horizon and model geometry. No new success score or confirmation draws.

partition_definition.primary_success: All original physics, acquisition form, upright, declared full route horizon and zero warning checks.
partition_definition.failed_without_required_clean_075s: Primary failure and existing0.75s clean bilateral gate not met; does not mean no contact.
partition_definition.acquired075_then_endpoint_or_support_gat: Existing0.75s gate met, primary failure, and existing endpoint hold or excluded support gate fails. Endpoint failure can mean fragmentation rather than total escape.
partition_definition.acquired075_endpoint_support_pass_other_: Existing0.75s, endpoint and no excluded support gates met, but another original criterion fails.

overlap_disclosure: Partition cells are mutually exclusive. Group counts and support presence overlap; first contact can include more than one group. The200ms chronology window is the existing form window and is descriptive, not a new gate.
